name: Bun sung
summary: Bún sung, also called bún tóp mỡ, is crab riêu with sliced sung and seasoned pork crackling. Tuổi Trẻ on 24 November 2021 places it at chợ Diên Hồng and prints 10,000 đồng, and a quoted hơn 10,000 đồng. Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 also names it at chợ Ngõ Ngang. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
origin: Nam Định. Tuổi Trẻ, 24 November 2021, and Dân Việt, 5 September 2025.
taste: Tuổi Trẻ calls the broth lightly sweet, smelling of đồng crab, with soft crab roe, crisp rich crackling, and a mild tannin from the sung. You mix the fruit with chili vinegar, sugar, and seasoning powder.
howToEat: Tuổi Trẻ says it fills students and workers in the early morning or after work, and that winter is when the bowl is at its best. One stall that day ran from 06:00 to 20:00. Whether that clock still holds is Check on arrival.

The same article prints 10,000 đồng for a full bowl and a resident’s hơn 10,000 đồng. Add-ons, chả cá, fried fish, mọc, or chả lá lốt, are 15,000–20,000 đồng. Both prices stay. A 2026 price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Diên Hồng on the 2021 account. Chợ Ngõ Ngang on the 5 September 2025 list. Both stay. A stall name was not used as the address.
priceBand: Tuổi Trẻ on 24 November 2021 prints 10,000 đồng and hơn 10,000 đồng, with add-ons at 15,000–20,000 đồng. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
